claims.claim_en: The noun 'Rabb' derives from the triliteral root r-b-b and denotes 'lord/owner/caretaker' in the general lexical sense.

claims.claim_en: Morphologically it appears on a geminated pattern (fa'') because of the doubled consonant in the root (r-b-b), hence the surface form 'Rabb' (a triliteral noun with gemination).
